notes.subject: אנוש
notes.rationale: Seheberu se bolela 'yo a swago ka mohuta' — motho wa sejo; 'motho' fela ga bontše sebopego seo.

notes.subject: רמה / תולעה
notes.rationale: Mantšu a mabedi a phane ka tatelano e bopago ngele; Sepedi o tshwana ka 'phane' ka bobedi, phapano e nyamilwe.

notes.subject: yo a lego
notes.rationale: Sepedi e nyaka kopanya yeo Seheberu se sa e bego sona.

translation: Gape ge e le kae mo go feta motho, yo a lego phane, le mora wa motho, yo a lego phane!

tokens.gloss: ge e le kae mo go feta
